questions.prompt: Which of the following commands preloads and manages existing SSH keys that are used for automatic authentication while logging in to other machines using SSH?

options.text: sshd
ssh-keyring
ssh-keygen
ssh-pki
ssh-agent

questions.explanation: ssh-agent es el programa en segundo plano que mantiene las claves privadas descifradas en memoria para que el usuario no tenga que escribir la frase de paso ( passphrase ) en cada conexión SSH.

questions.prompt: On a machine running several X servers, how do programs identify the different instances of the X11 server?

options.text: By a fixed UUID that is defined in the X11 configuration file.
By a display name like :1 .
By the name of the user that runs the X server like x11: bob.
By a device name like /dev/X11/xservers/1.
By a unique IPv6 address from the fe80::/64subne t.

questions.explanation: Cada instancia de servidor X11 en una máquina se identifica por su número de display precedido por dos puntos ( :0 para el primero, :1 para el segundo, etc., con el formato completo hostname:displaynumber.screennumber ).

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a screen reader?

options.text: It manages virtual keyboards on touch screen displays.
It reads the parameters of the attached monitors and creates an appropriate X11 configuration.
It displays lines and markers to help people use speed reading techniques.
It manages and displays files that contain e-books.
It reads displayed text to accommodate the needs of blind or visually impaired people.

questions.explanation: Un lector de pantalla ( screen reader , como Orca o BrlTTY en Linux) es una tecnología de accesibilidad que interpreta el texto mostrado en pantalla y lo envía a un sintetizador de voz o a una línea Braille para personas ciegas o con discapacidad visual.

questions.prompt: The X11 configuration file xorg.conf is grouped into section. How is the content of the section SectionName represented?

options.text: It is placed in curly brackets as in Section SectionName {…}.
It is placed between the tags <Section " name=""SectionName"> and </Section> .
It is placed between a line containing Section "SectionName" and a line containing EndSect ion.
It is placed af ter the row [SectionName].
It is placed after an initial unindented Section "SectionName" and must be indented by exactly one tab character.

questions.explanation: Según man xorg.conf , la sintaxis de cada bloque en xorg.conf comienza con Section "SectionName" y se cierra con la palabra clave EndSection .

questions.prompt: Which of the following features are provided by SPICE? (Choose two.).

options.text: Connecting local USB devices to remote applications.
Accessing graphical applications on a remote host.
Replacing Xorg as local X11 server.
Downloading and locally installing applications from a remote machin e.
Uploading and running a binary program on a rem ote machine.

questions.explanation: El protocolo SPICE ( Simple Protocol for Independent Computing Environments ), muy usado en virtualización KVM/QEMU, permite visualizar e interactuar con entornos gráficos remotos y redirigir dispositivos USB locales hacia la máquina remota/virtual. questions.prompt: What is the systemd journal stored? (Where is the systemd journal stored?)

options.text: /var/jlog/and /var/jlogd/
/proc/log/and /proc/klog/
/run/log/journal/ or /var/log/journal/
/var/log/syslog.binor /var/log/syslog.jrn
/etc/systemd/journal/or /usr/lib/systemd/journal/

questions.explanation: systemd-journald guarda los registros de forma volátil (en memoria RAM) dentro de /run/log/journal/ o de forma persistente en disco si existe el directorio /var/log/journal/ .

questions.prompt: Which of the following is true regarding the command sendmail?

options.text: With any MTA, the sendmail command must be run periodically by the cron daemon.
When using systemd, sendmail is an alias to relayctl.
The sendmail command prints the MTA's queue history of which mails have been sent successfully.
It is only available when the sendm ail MTA is installed.
All common MTAs, including Postfix and Exim, provide a sendmail comma nd.

questions.explanation: Por razones de compatibilidad histórica con scripts y aplicaciones de Unix que envían correo invocando /usr/sbin/sendmail , todos los MTA principales (Postfix, Exim, qmail, etc.) incluyen un binario o wrapper llamado sendmail .

questions.prompt: Which file inside the CUPS configuration directory contains the settings of the printers?

options.text: cups-devices.conf
snmp.conf
printers.conf
printcap.conf
cupsd.conf

questions.explanation: Dentro de /etc/cups/ , el archivo printers.conf define las colas e impresoras configuradas localmente, mientras que cupsd.conf configura el comportamiento general del demonio CUPS.

questions.prompt: What does the term Braille Display refer to?

options.text: A standardized high contract graphical theme for desktop applications?
A Linux desktop environment similar to KDE and GNOME.
A legacy display technology superseded by LCD.
A physical representation of characters using small dots.
A standard file format for data exchange, similar to XM L.

questions.explanation: Una línea o pantalla Braille ( Braille Display ) es un dispositivo hardware electromecánico de accesibilidad que levanta pequeños puntos físicos redondeados a través de una superficie plana para que los usuarios ciegos puedan leer el texto de la pantalla mediante el tacto.

questions.prompt: Which environment variable is used by an X11 client to determine the X Server to connect to? (Specify only the variable name without any preceding commands or values.).
questions.explanation: Cualquier cliente gráfico X11 consulta la variable de entorno DISPLAY para saber a qué servidor X, pantalla y monitor debe conectarse.

questions.prompt: Which of the following tasks are handled by a display manager like XDM or KMD? (Choose two.).

options.text: Configure additional devices like new monitors or projectors when they are attached.
Start and prepare the desktop environment for the user.
Create an X11 configuration file for the current graphic devices and monitors.
Lock the screen when the user was inactive for a configurable amount of time.
Handle the login of a user.

questions.explanation: Un gestor de pantalla ( Display Manager como XDM, GDM, KDM, SDDM o LightDM) presenta la pantalla gráfica de inicio de sesión, autentica las credenciales del usuario ( Handle the login of a user ) y posteriormente inicia su sesión de escritorio ( Start and prepare the desktop environment for the user ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following protocols is designed to access the video card output of a virtual machine?

options.text: KDE
Xfce
SPICE
XDMCP

questions.explanation: SPICE es un protocolo de visualización remota diseñado específicamente para entornos virtualizados (como KVM/QEMU), permitiendo acceder directamente a la salida gráfica de la tarjeta de vídeo virtualizada, audio y puertos USB de la máquina virtual.
